items.title: Exam alerts: CSIR and ISRO added
items.text: CSIR wants 23 MTS (10th pass, last date 21 Dec 2026). The exam is like SSC MTS and PwD pay no fee. See Exam alerts → CSIR. ISRO Kerala centres are also watched every day now.

items.title: New: Exam alerts
items.text: Open More → Exam alerts. You will see application start and last dates, exam dates and the official apply link for SSC, Railway and Kerala PSC, all in simple English. Kerala PSC posts are explained in English. Tap 'I applied' after you apply. Today will remind you 10 days before a last date.

items.title: New: Marks finder and target score
items.text: Today shows the 3 topics where your study time gains the most marks. Tap Practise 10 to start. Set your target score on the Full mock page; after each mock it shows how many more marks you need in each subject.

items.title: New: picture questions
items.text: Mirror image, water image and paper folding questions with real pictures. Every full mock now has a paper folding question.

items.title: New: GK memory cards and Sunday review
items.text: Every GK or current affairs question you get wrong becomes a card that comes back after 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days. On Sundays, Today shows your week: minutes, classes, questions, your most common mistakes and next week's focus.

items.title: New: report a wrong question
items.text: After answering, tap ⚑ Report this question if something is wrong. It is hidden from your practice at once, and you can send it to the morning update to fix.

items.title: Classes you attend now count
items.text: When you pass a class test (or tap Mark done), that day counts as studied: 1 class = a study day, 2 classes = a full day, and each class adds 45 minutes to Today's study. Days when you already passed a test are fixed too.

items.title: Pop-up quiz: sound and shorter gaps
items.text: Pop-up questions now play a sound on the phone and PC (turn it off in My day → Pop-up quiz → Sound). You can also choose a gap of 5, 10, 15, 20 or 25 minutes.

items.title: New: help for PwD students
items.text: My day now has PwD exam rules with a checklist, and reading settings: an easy-to-read font, more line space, a background colour, a reading ruler, words that light up while the app reads, and Simple mode.

items.title: New in Practice
items.text: 2-minute speed drills (tables, squares, fractions to %), a 5-question mini set, a 15-minute study block, and scribe practice. Maths mistakes now show a picture too (ratio, time and work, speed).

items.title: Current affairs for 26 November added
items.text: 16 news items and an 8-question quiz. From now on the update runs every morning at 4:45 AM, and you will see a message here when something important changes.
